Ridgecrest Catalog Knowledge Graph — GraphRAG Output (prompt-engineered)

Full entity–relationship graph automatically extracted by GraphRAG from the 2019 Ridgecrest catalog, using the seismology-oriented prompt-engineering scheme (Section 5), no hand-designed schema.

Note: GraphRAG's own 2D embedding only placed 390 of the entities (the graph fragmented into many small disconnected components under the stricter prompt-engineered relationship rule); the remaining 4,450 entities have no GraphRAG-computed position and are shown at reduced opacity, laid out component-by-component in the gallery area to avoid misrepresenting them as part of the same embedding space.
